content.short: TON Web IDE is a browser-based environment for writing and compiling TON smart contracts without local setup.
content.description: TON Web IDE is a convenient and accessible browser-based integrated development environment for the TON blockchain. It allows developers to write, compile, and debug smart contracts directly in the browser, eliminating the need for complex local setup or specialized hardware. Featuring a clean interface, real-time compilation, and integration with TON wallets, the Web IDE is an excellent tool for rapid prototyping, learning the FunC or Tact languages, and quickly deploying experimental contracts to the TON testnet or mainnet.
content.meta: Start coding for TON instantly with the TON Web IDE. Browser-based development on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
